patches.name: Call recording
patches.description: Automatically records every incoming and outgoing Voice call (both sides) to Recordings/Voice calls. Works for calls made over Wi-Fi or mobile data, not calls Voice routes through the carrier.

patches.name: Debug log
patches.description: Saves the app's own log to Downloads/voice-logcat-<time>.txt each time the app starts, including every push message it receives. For troubleshooting only.

patches.name: Default phone app
patches.description: Lets Google Voice be chosen as the default phone app (Settings > Apps > Default apps > Phone app). Tapping a phone number then opens Voice, and carrier calls get a basic in-call screen.

patches.name: GmsCore support
patches.description: Lets Voice sign in and get calls/texts without root by using MicroG RE (install it from Morphe Manager) instead of Google Play Services. Also gives the app its own package name, so it installs next to the original.

options.description: Package name the patched app is installed under.

patches.name: Incoming call fix
patches.description: Makes incoming calls ring with MicroG. MicroG can't wake the app for calls like Google Play Services does, so the app briefly shows an invisible overlay when a call comes in. Needs "Appear on top", which the app asks for once.
